entities.name: The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian
aliases: The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The startling, incredibly supercilious tone of this man who had once been his valet, was extraordinary in itself.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: I kept thinking of Dmitri. Brother, brother! Ach!” He suddenly clutched his head in both hands.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ivan jumped up and seized him by the shoulder. “Tell me everything, you viper! Tell me everything!”

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Under the wrapper were three packets of hundred-rouble notes. “They are all here, all the three thousand roubles; you need not count them. Take them,” Smerdyakov suggested to Ivan

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.object: The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian
triples.quote: took up the big yellow book that Ivan had noticed at first lying on the table, and put it over the notes. The book was _The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian_.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: “It was only with you, with your help, I killed him, and Dmitri Fyodorovitch is quite innocent.”

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: _You_ murdered him; you are the real murderer, I was only your instrument, your faithful servant, and it was following your words I did it.”

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: I could always have cornered you, revealing your eagerness for your father’s death, and I tell you the public would have believed it all

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: He suddenly believed it; he was all of a shake—he was awfully crazy about her—and he leaned right out of the window.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I went to the window and shouted to the master, ‘It’s I.’ And he shouted to me, ‘He’s been, he’s been; he’s run away.’

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: And so I want to prove to your face this evening that you are the only real murderer in the whole affair, and I am not the real murderer, though I did kill him.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: So I could always have clambered up to the ikons and have taken away the money next morning or even that night, and it would have all been put down to Dmitri Fyodorovitch.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I snatched up that iron paper-weight from his table; do you remember, weighing about three pounds? I swung it and hit him on the top of the skull with the corner of it.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I wiped the paper-weight, put it back, went up to the ikons, took the money out of the envelope, and flung the envelope on the floor and the pink ribbon beside it.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: you’re so sorry for your brother that you are sacrificing yourself to save him and have invented it all against me

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: That was quite right what you taught me, for you talked a lot to me about that.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Listen, you miserable, contemptible creature! Don’t you understand that if I haven’t killed you, it’s simply because I am keeping you to answer to-morrow at the trial.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Ivan took the three rolls of notes and put them in his pocket without wrapping them in anything.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Smerdyakov lifted the book off the notes and laid it on one side. “Take that money away with you,” Smerdyakov sighed.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: and had even bragged aloud before every one that he’d go and take his property from Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: You are like Fyodor Pavlovitch, you are more like him than any of his children; you’ve the same soul as he had.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Just as he reached his own house he stopped short, asking himself suddenly hadn’t he better go at once to the prosecutor and tell him everything.
